facts.parking: There are 8 ADA accessible parking spaces available within 400 feet of the entrance. Parking surfaces are concrete and the mobility access area aisles are wooden cobbles. The pathways are aggregate paving (not loose surface).

facts.parking: Free general parking is available on the Library campus, a short walk from the main entrance. Lots accommodate standard vehicles, accessible parking, and drop-off areas for those with mobility needs. Designated oversized vehicle parking areas are provided for RVs, buses, and motorcoaches.
